from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Operating cash flow reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company the report belongs to, as named in the document")
    cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="The operating cash flow amount as a numeric value")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="How this metric is labeled in the document (e.g. 经营活动产生的现金流量净额)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g. 2024年第一季度)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g. 元)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_cash_flows: list[OperatingCashFlow]
